summary.text: Nathan Nelson is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has represented House District 11B since March 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a third-generation farmer who is passionate about agriculture and small business.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Nelson took office in the Minnesota House of Representatives on March 27, 2019.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy, Children and Families Finance and Policy (as co-vice chair), and Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy committees.
The Republican primary for his seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
In the 2020 survey, Nelson said he was born and raised in the district and is the third generation to farm the family farm.
He said he has been involved in the community through 4-H, University of Minnesota Extension and Farm Bureau.
